descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has graceful and colorful red foliage and forms a small neat, compact, rounded bush, making it The elongate-ovate lobes have long, slender tail-like tips and are 12-15 mm wide at the broadest point in the middle, narrowing to 3-5 mm at the lobe junctions which are within 10 mm of the leaf base. The margins are regularlyserratedwithnumerousfinenarrow-pointedteeth. The short red petioles are 1-3. 5 cm long. The lobe tips tend to curve downwards slightly like, as the Greer Gardens (Eugene, Oregon) catalog so aptly puts it, "a relaxed hand. " 'Oregon Sunset' is a good small tree for limited space.

sources.title: 俄勒冈日落 Acer Palmatum 'Oregon Sunset'
sources.description: 俄勒冈日落具有 非常 出色的春季和秋季色彩 ，春天是 叶子呈柔和的红色，很快变成 紫 红色 。 夏季会适当返绿， 到了秋天变成 日落光辉般的橙红橙黄色调 。 叶子中等大小，具有 5-7裂，叶边缘有锯齿。 叶片呈 长卵状披针形 ，叶尖微微向下弯曲。 生长紧凑、圆润，是盆景造型和小型花园的理想选择， 成年树高约2米。

rhs.description: A compact deciduous shrub or small tree, to around 1. 5m high, with a upright then spreading habit and deeply lobed leaves that emerge reddish and mature to deep olive and plum tones, before turning bright orange-red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained, ideally slightly acidic soil, in a sheltered position with protection from drying winds. Thrives in part shade, though some sun is needed to develop the leaf colour; will tolerate full sun if soil is reliably moist. Mulch in spring, especially when grown in containers , to improve moisture retention. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Minimal pruning required; see pruning group 1 . Prune from late autumn to mid-winter only

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种叶色红艳而富于变化，姿态优雅，可形成小型、整齐、紧凑、圆头状灌木，因此非常适合空间有限的种植环境。 其裂片为狭长卵形，先端细长如尾，裂片中部最宽处为 12–15 mm，向下收窄，在距叶基 10 mm 以内的裂片连接处仅 3–5 mm 宽。 叶缘规则锯齿状，具许多细而尖的齿。 红色短叶柄长 1–3. 5 cm。 裂片先端常略向下弯曲，正如 Greer Gardens（俄勒冈州尤金）目录中贴切描述的那样，如同“放松的手”。 ‘Oregon Sunset’ 是适合小空间栽植的优良小乔木。

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。
attributes.suggested_uses: 造型植物、城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低养护、庭院/容器植物

care.pruning: 所需修剪极少；参见修剪第 1 组。仅可在晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好、排水良好、最好为微酸性的土壤中，种植位置应避风，并防止干燥风侵袭。半阴环境下生长最佳，但需要一定日照以促进叶色表现；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。春季应覆盖 mulch，尤其是容器栽培时，可帮助保持土壤水分。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用压条或嫁接繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑型落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 1. 5 米，株形先直立后开展；叶片深裂，新叶带红色，成熟后呈深橄榄色与李紫色调，秋季转为鲜亮的橙红色。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Oregon Sunset' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Oregon Sunset' Oregon Sunset Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Oregon Sunset' leafs out in the early spring with large rounded plum colored leaves and a growth habit with lots of lateral yet slightly upright branching. This forms a beautiful mid-sized spreading Japanese maple reaching about 7 ft in height by 10 ft wide in 20 years. This size and shape makes this Japanese maple an ideal Japanese maple for small garden spaces. Fall colors are the colors of a sunset, brilliant shades of orange & red. If you want an even smaller tree in height trim out the central leader at an early age creating a wide-spreading red Japanese maple with a large palmate leaf. Examples of this can be seen at the JC Raulston Arboretum at NC State. This gives a great alternative and provides a lot of color while not blocking vision elsewhere in the garden. For best growth, we recommend protection from the hot afternoon sun.
